text:
Elena (CSM): OceanicMed asked for a practical enablement: embeddings quality checks, similarity thresholds, and a short rollout checklist. Theyre mid-onboarding and we have a renewal check-in in ~4 weeks. Can we run a 90m hands-on next Thu that includes a 15m renewal sync at the end?
Hector (Enablement): Thu afternoon PT works for me. 90m with a 30m optional office-hours the following week sounds good.
Nia (Solutions Eng): Ill need a 45m preflight to validate their VPC allowlist and sample payloads. Recommend we pin model rwd-7b-embed-int8 for the lab.
Cal (Renewals): I can join the final 15m to capture adoption metrics and executive asks. Please reserve 10m for contract/usage concerns.
Elena (CSM): cal-bot, can you tentatively schedule and include a follow-up 30m office hours slot one week after?
cal-bot: Tentative event created: "OceanicMed: Embed Quality Lab + Renewal Pulse (tentative)" Thu 2026-04-09 15:00-16:30 PT. Office hours Thu 2026-04-16 15:00-15:30 PT. Invite: https://cal.redwood.ai/e/oceanicmed-embed-456.
Hector (Enablement): Draft agenda: 5m intros & goals, 20m data/metric review, 45m hands-on tuning + eval (notebook + sandbox), 10m cost ops & rollout checklist, 10-15m renewal pulse. Add a quick feedback survey at the end.
Nia (Solutions Eng): Preflight checklist we need from them by Fri EOD: sample CSV (<=8k rows), test embeddings key, infra contact for VPC allowlist, and a small set of labeled pairs for eval (10-50). If not provided, we'll use sanitized examples.
Elena (CSM): Ive pinged OceanicMed for payloads and infra contact. Also asked for their expected queries/day and latency SLO.
Cal (Renewals): Noting their renewal concern: inconsistent similarity scores and rising cost. Hector, please include a "quick wins" slide (batching, cache TTLs, model pin).
Hector (Enablement): Will do. Also planning a short demo of a precision@k notebook and a simple thresholding rule.
Nia (Solutions Eng): Sharing a minimal curl they can run to validate keys:
```
# validate embeddings key + model
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer TEST_EMBED_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-embed-int8","input":"sample clinical note for triage"}'
```
Elena (CSM): If we get their materials by Fri, Nia and I will run preflight Mon morning. If not, proceed with demo-first and schedule a post-lab data validation call.
Hector (Enablement): Also adding a 5-min section on "when to roll back" and safe rollout metrics (latency, false positive alerts).
Cal (Renewals): I'll prepare a one-slide renewal summary and include adoption metrics to circulate with the invite.
Elena (CSM): Any objections to Thu 15:00 PT?
Hector (Enablement): No objections. :thumbsup:
Nia (Solutions Eng): All good.
cal-bot: Reminder: preflight checklist due Fri 2026-04-03 17:00 PT.
Elena (CSM): Thanks team I'll post the final agenda and the feedback form here after OceanicMed confirms.
